performance.verdict: SOW delivery failure is the real crisis; Meta CPL decay is secondary.

findings.text: 10 SOW milestones overdue by 47–107 days: stack test, GHL migration, CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close all undelivered.
CPL spiked 56.55% week-over-week while leads fell 17.39%; 3-day signal (Oct 14–16) averages 3 leads/day vs 5.7 leads/day the prior 3 days — deterioration is confirmed, not noise.
Single campaign MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP absorbed $1,093.75 of $1,160.05 (28d spend) with no creative rotation evident; flat-to-rising spend with falling leads is textbook creative fatigue.
GBP actions collapsed 96.87% week-over-week (from ~16 actions on Oct 8 to 0 on Oct 13–16) while paid spend held — organic and local presence effectively went dark.
GA4 sessions averaged 85/day Oct 14–16 vs 78/day prior 3 days — sessions are stable, meaning lead conversion rate on-site is the drop point, not traffic volume.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; no budget scale until stack test and tracking are live.
suggestions.monday_update: Ten SOW milestones are overdue between 47 and 107 days, including the pre-launch stack test, GHL/Como migration, CAPI setup, landing pages, and search campaign launch. No paid channel can be properly attributed or scaled until the end-to-end stack test passes and tracking is verified live. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) by 2026-10-20 with a revised delivery date for each item. Success check: stack test confirmed complete and at least 3 remaining milestones have firm new dates by 2026-10-24.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new ad creative into MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP; cap budget shift to ≤20% until new creative shows CPL improvement.
suggestions.monday_update: MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP has absorbed $1,093.75 over 28 days and is the sole active campaign; CPL rose 56.55% week-over-week while leads fell 17.39%, consistent with creative fatigue. Introduce at least one new ad creative variant into the campaign by 2026-10-21. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $9.43 within 7 days of the new creative going live; re-evaluate on 2026-10-28.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions daily; if zero-action streak extends past Oct 20, flag for GBP triage already overdue per SOW.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped 96.87% week-over-week and have read zero for the last 4 days (Oct 13–16). GBP triage was a July 31 SOW milestone that remains undelivered. Watch daily actions through Oct 20; if the streak continues, this becomes an urgent SOW fix item to raise with Nacer alongside the broader milestone escalation. Success check: GBP actions return to a non-zero daily read by 2026-10-20.
